name: Atlantean (Legendary Games)
body:
According to the legend, Atlanteans were the people of a fable, golden-age continent that sunk to the bottom of the sea because of their arrogance, or maybe because of the gods’ envy. They were the most perfect of humanoid races, and the most culturally and technologically advanced, having created machines that defied gravity and the legendary metal orichalcum, with great magic and scientific powers.

According to some scholars, atlanteans could be the ancestors of all the humanoid races existing today, that evolved in different ways depending on their environment or alignment after the primeval land’s fall. Every now and then, some children are born in every race that bear some trait reminding of that former glory (here, we present only half-atlanteans of human descent). In the far future, prophets precognize, when all humanoids learn to live in peace with each other and mingle, the First Race will be born again from repeated interracial matings, bringing a new Golden Age of peace and progress on earth.

Standard Racial Features
Ability Score Modifiers: +2 Intelligence, +2 Charisma. Atlantean are the most intelligent and perfect humanoid that ever lived (at least, so they say).
Size: Medium
Speed: Normal
Type: Humanoid. (atlantean)
Languages: Linguist Common, Atlantean. An atlantean can learn any languages she wants if she has a high Intelligence score.
Feat and Skill Racial Features
Magic Training: Knowledge (arcana) and Use Magic Device are always class skills for an atlantean. If they choose a class that has either of these skills as class skills, they gain a +2 racial bonus on those skills instead.
Skill Bonus x2: Atlanteans gain a +2 racial bonus on Perception and Swim.
Magical Racial Features
Constant Spell-Like Divination (Advanced Trait): Atlanteans can use detect magic as a constant spell-like ability. Their caster level is equal to their character level.
Seaspeech: Atlanteans have the ability to converse with sea animals as if subject to a continual speak with animals spell.
Half-Atlantean
Senses Racial Features
Ability Score Modifiers: Human Heritage. Half-atlanteans gain a +2 to any single ability score of their choice.
Size: Medium
Speed: Normal
Type: Humanoid. (atlantean, human)
Senses: Low-light vision
Languages: Linguist Common, Atlantean. A half-atlantean can learn any languages she wants if she has a high Intelligence score.
Feat and Skill Racial Features
Flexible Bonus Feat: Like their human parents, half-atlanteans gain a bonus feat at 1st level.
Keen Senses: Half-atlanteans have a +2 racial bonus on Perception skill checks.
Magical Racial Features
Envoy: Half-atlanteans with an Intelligence score of 11 or more can cast detect magic once per day as a spell-like ability. Its caster level is equal to the half-atlantean’s character level.
Senses Racial Features
Senses: Low-light vision
